findings.message: Audible clips overlap on Studio track 4: assets/sfx/pop.mp3 at 0.5-1.1s and assets/sfx/pop.mp3 at 0.94-1.54s. Both play at once whatever their track (the render mixes every audible clip; data-track-index only picks the Studio lane), and Studio draws them over each other in that lane.
findings.fixHint: If both should sound (a whoosh into a hit), give one its own data-track-index; the mix does not change. If one is a leftover duplicate, remove it or move it so the windows do not overlap.

findings.message: <video id="treev"> has data-start="3" inside a sub-composition. Nested media timing is local to its composition by default; a nonzero value can be confused with a legacy root-global timestamp.
findings.fixHint: Keep data-start="3" if it is composition-local. If this is a legacy root-global timestamp, add data-hf-media-start-basis="global"; otherwise convert it to local time by subtracting the host start.
